clips.text: Be in a state of perfectly quiet passivity - then you are in harmony with the world.

The thought-forms dissolve automatically because they cannot exist with total passivity: they are forms of an activity-addicted mind, and with them dissolves the ego - because it cannot exist without thought-forms.
The ego is nothing but a whirlpool center of constantly revolving thought-forms.
Remain in passivity, that is, in the state of absolute doing-nothingness, and meditation deepens to the depths where there is no meditator.
And remember that only when there is no meditator has meditation really come into being.
If you are then there is no meditation, and when there is meditation you are not.
